The team is dedicated to creating memorable experiences for guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to service excellence. d62df959bbf6d20f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الابنية للاستشارات الهندسية عن أخصائي جغرافيا للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة العوامل الجغرافية وتحديد الثروات الطبيعية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الاستشارات في مشاريع العقارات والاتصالات وتشييد المباني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة معدلات الأمطار والحرارة، وطبيعة التكوين الجغرافي للمناطق، بما في ذلك الجبال والسواحل والأنهار وحدودها الجغرافية. تحديد الثروات الطبيعية للمناطق، مثل الثروات المائية وتوزيعها وانتظامها، وتقييم إمكانية استغلالها في الزراعة. تحديد المحاصيل الزراعية ومعدلات التصدير والاستيراد للمنتجات الزراعية، والبحث في الثروات الحيوانية ومدى كفايتها. تحديد الثروات المعدنية والمناجم، ومعدلات استخراجها وتعدينها. دراسة شبكات النقل البحري والبري والجوي من حيث تغطيتها الجغرافية للمناطق. تقديم النصيحة والمشورة للحكومة بشأن العقارات ومشاريع الاتصالات وتشييد المباني ومشاريع الطاقة. تحديد أماكن شق الطرق وتعبيدها، وتطبيق تكنولوجيا نظم المعلومات الجغرافية (GIS). المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الجغرافيا أو تخصص ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات الجغرافية وتحديد الأنماط. المهارات المطلوبة معرفة قوية بالعوامل الجغرافية المختلفة. القدرة على تطبيق تكنولوجيا نظم المعلومات الجغرافية (GIS). مهارات تحليلية وبحثية ممتازة. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم الاستشارات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي الجغرافيا ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الابنية للاستشارات الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

d611e7b850f11bb6.description: Job description Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable. This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure. We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects. Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision. What You Will Do ❓ Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. What Are We Looking For❓ Essential Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, prioritizing algorithmic depth over superficial multi-language breadth. Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns. Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience. Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software. Comprehensive mental model of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management. Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives. Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors. Expectations by Seniority Level Core requirements apply universally, with ownership and operational scale adjusting based on candidate seniority. Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Prior agentic experience is not required; mentorship is provided to expand scope over well-defined modules. Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production services. Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations. Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling. Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling. Active open-source contributions or community engagement. Out of Scope Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem. Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation. Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows. Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning. Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally. Technical Standards & Architecture Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-office, and hybrid work setups. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

The role ensures that operational requirements, maintainability considerations, logistical needs, support facilities, and service delivery requirements are appropriately integrated into asset designs and associated development proposals. As the Estate Management design authority for operability and maintainability, the Director provides independent review, challenge, assurance, and recommendations for all assets requiring future operations, maintenance, management, or service delivery. The position coordinates operational aspects of asset handover activities with City Asset Management to facilitate a smooth transition from development into operations. Key Responsibilities Lead operational design reviews to ensure assets are operable, maintainable, functional, and sustainable throughout their lifecycle. Assess designs across all project stages, identifying operational risks, maintenance constraints, and service delivery challenges. Provide recommendations to improve asset performance, accessibility, safety, and long-term operational efficiency. Develop and maintain operational design standards, requirements, review frameworks, and assurance processes. Ensure operational, maintenance, and service delivery requirements are embedded within development and governance processes. Review and validate the planning, sizing, location, and functionality of operational support facilities and infrastructure. Assess logistics, access, servicing, maintenance, and emergency arrangements to optimize operational effectiveness and resilience. Provide operational design expertise, facilitate stakeholder collaboration, and align development, delivery, and asset management objectives. Manage consultants and technical advisors, ensuring deliverables meet operational requirements and support sustainable outcomes. Support design governance, asset handovers, continuous improvement initiatives, lessons learned, reporting, and operational readiness assurance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain operational design requirements. Experience coordinating stakeholder alignment and supporting district and development teams. Proven capability in managing specialist consultant activities related to operational design assurance. Strong understanding of designing assets for safe, efficient, and sustainable operation throughout their lifecycle. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring onsite attendance at a Jacobs Workplace. The role involves close collaboration with Development, Delivery, City Operations, Community Management, Asset Management, Utilities, Mobility, Security, Digital, and other operational stakeholders. About Jacobs Jacobs is committed to solving critical global problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery, and cutting-edge manufacturing. The company focuses on turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Jacobs fosters a culture of caring, connecting employees locally and globally, and leveraging diverse perspectives and backgrounds. The company prioritizes safety and flexibility, offering support and space for employees to maximize their potential.

d67b24b600bc91ee.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Senior Employee Relations Officer for a full-time position. This role involves leading and overseeing the employee relations function, ensuring effective management of employee relations issues, and promoting a positive work environment within the organization. Role Overview The Senior Employee Relations Officer provides strategic direction and guidance on complex employee relations matters, including grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, and labor disputes. This position is key in developing and implementing employee relations policies, procedures, and programs to foster a culture of fairness, respect, and compliance with employment laws and regulations. The role also involves collaboration with senior management and HR leadership to address systemic issues and develop initiatives that improve employee engagement and morale. Administer HR services precisely and timely, maintaining high-quality standards for all transactions. Monitor and control employee data to ensure timely processing and compliance with relevant policies. Assist in investigating and conducting disciplinary cases, preparing case briefs, and following up on agreed actions. Coordinate with the recruitment and business partnership section to plan and arrange induction for new recruits, and advise new staff on company employee relations policies and procedures. Coordinate the planning of employee leaves across different divisions and departments. Manage the resolution of employee HR inquiries and grievances, ensuring adequate support is provided. Process and communicate employee action letters, including promotions, salary adjustments, and disciplinary actions. Communicate and circulate new and updated policies, procedures, and regulations to company employees. Create, maintain, and update employee files while ensuring confidentiality. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. d67ca5513b738bb5.job_title: أخصائي إدارة حسابات تواصل إجتماعي محتوى
d67ca5513b738bb5.description: المسمى الوظيفي أخصائي كتابة محتوى إبداعي وحسابات التواصل الاجتماعي الهدف من الوظيفة صناعة وكتابة المحتوى الإبداعي للمؤسسة وإدارة حساباتها على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، بما يعزز حضور العلامة التجارية، ويرفع مستوى التفاعل مع الجمهور، ويضمن اتساق الرسائل والمحتوى مع الهوية والأهداف التسويقية والاتصالية للمؤسسة. المهام والمسؤوليات إعداد وكتابة المحتوى الإبداعي لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي والمواقع والمنصات الرقمية. ابتكار وتطوير الأفكار الإبداعية للحملات والمبادرات والمناسبات بما يتناسب مع هوية العلامة التجارية وأهدافها. إدارة وتشغيل حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي، بما يشمل إعداد المحتوى وجدولته ونشره ومتابعة التفاعل. إعداد خطط وجداول المحتوى الأسبوعية والشهرية وفق الأهداف التسويقية والاتصالية. كتابة النصوص الترويجية، والمنشورات، والعناوين، والنصوص القصيرة للفيديوهات والقصص الرقمية. متابعة التوجهات الحديثة في صناعة المحتوى ومنصات التواصل الاجتماعي وتوظيفها بما يخدم العلامة التجارية. التنسيق مع فرق التصميم والتصوير والإنتاج لضمان تحويل الأفكار والمحتوى إلى مواد بصرية متكاملة. متابعة تعليقات واستفسارات الجمهور والتفاعل معها وفق أسلوب وهوية المؤسسة. رصد أداء الحسابات وتحليل مؤشرات التفاعل والوصول والنمو، وإعداد التقارير والتوصيات التطويرية. المساهمة في إدارة الحملات الرقمية والإعلانية وصياغة الرسائل والمحتوى الخاص بها. ضمان الالتزام بنبرة وهوية العلامة التجارية في جميع المواد والمحتويات المنشورة. متابعة المحتوى المنشور ورصد الملاحظات أو الأزمات الرقمية والتعامل معها بالتنسيق مع الإدارة المختصة. البحث المستمر عن الموضوعات والأفكار ذات الصلة باهتمامات الجمهور وتحويلها إلى محتوى قابل للنشر. المساهمة في بناء مجتمع رقمي متفاعل حول العلامة التجارية وتعزيز صورتها وحضورها لدى الجمهور. متابعة أفضل الممارسات في مجال صناعة المحتوى وإدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، ومقارنة أداء المؤسسة بالممارسات والمعايير المتبعة لدى المؤسسات الرائدة، وتحديد فرص التحسين والتطوير. اقتراح مبادرات وأفكار جديدة لتطوير المحتوى وتعزيز الحضور الرقمي ورفع مستوى التفاعل مع الجمهور. المؤهلات والمهارات درجة البكالوريوس أو الدبلوم في الإعلام، العلاقات العامة، التسويق، الاتصال، اللغة العربية أو أي تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة في كتابة المحتوى الإبداعي وإدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. معرفة جيدة بخصائص ومتطلبات منصات التواصل الاجتماعي المختلفة. مهارات قوية في البحث، وتوليد الأفكار، وصناعة المحتوى. قدرة عالية على الكتابة وصياغة الرسائل بأسلوب إبداعي وجذاب. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع المصممين والمصورين وفرق الإنتاج. الإلمام بأدوات إدارة وجدولة المحتوى وتحليل أداء الحسابات. القدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة والالتزام بالمواعيد والجداول الزمنية. معرفة جيدة بالاتجاهات الرقمية الحديثة وسلوك الجمهور على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. مهارات جيدة في التحليل وقراءة مؤشرات الأداء واستخلاص التوصيات.

d6cae32d662e0ce0.description: About the Role Crown Holdings is seeking a skilled Front End Mechanic to join its team in Makkah, specifically covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the operational efficiency and safety of the company's fleet through comprehensive maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on various vehicles and equipment. Role Overview The Front End Mechanic will be responsible for ensuring that all vehicles and industrial machinery are in optimal working condition. This involves performing both routine preventative maintenance and addressing complex mechanical issues to minimize downtime and ensure compliance with safety standards. The role requires a proactive approach to identifying potential problems and executing timely repairs. Key Responsibilities Perform routine and preventative maintenance on a variety of vehicles and equipment, including trucks, forklifts, and other industrial machinery. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and equipment. Repair and replace defective parts, including components of engines, transmissions, brakes, steering, suspension, and hydraulic systems. Conduct thorough inspections to identify potential problems and ensure adherence to safety standards. Perform welding and fabrication tasks as required for repairs and modifications. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all maintenance and repair work performed. Adhere strictly to all company safety policies and procedures. Assist with the inventory management of parts and supplies. Collaborate effectively with other team members to ensure efficient workflow and timely completion of tasks. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with operational duties spanning Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a team environment, focused on maintaining a diverse fleet of vehicles and industrial equipment to support company operations. Application Process Candidates interested in this Front End Mechanic position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact.

d6dd747799a36dbb.description: About the Role TikTok is seeking an Account Manager (Growth) for its Global Business Solutions (GBS) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving revenue growth and client success for a diverse portfolio of advertisers across the MENA region. The position is nationalized in accordance with the requirements of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development and is available only to Saudi national citizens or individuals who qualify for equivalent status for Saudization purposes. Role Context and Impact The Growth team within TikTok's Global Business Solutions helps businesses and brands achieve growth by connecting with their audiences on the platform. This role combines commercial expertise with a customer-centric approach to assist advertisers in reaching their marketing objectives and scaling their operations. The Account Manager will build trusted relationships with clients, identify opportunities for increased investment, and provide strategic guidance to help them succeed on TikTok. Key Responsibilities Manage and expand a portfolio of SMB advertisers across the Middle East, focusing on revenue growth and long-term client success. Cultivate trusted relationships with advertisers to identify opportunities for increased investment and business scaling on TikTok. Develop account strategies tailored to client objectives, performance metrics, seasonality, and market opportunities. Promote the adoption of TikTok's advertising products, measurement solutions, and best practices among clients. Identify, reactivate, and develop high-potential advertisers within the assigned portfolio. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to resolve client challenges and facilitate growth. Maintain strong sales discipline in pipeline management, forecasting, client engagement, and opportunity planning. Share market and client insights to contribute to TikTok's SMB strategy across the region. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in sales and account management. Demonstrated expertise in digital advertising. Strong analytical thinking skills. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative work environment. Fluency in Arabic is required for this role. The position requires a professional who can adapt to constantly shifting client needs, market trends, and performance expectations to develop effective advertising solutions and lasting client partnerships. d6199de1a11b001f.description: نبحث عن موظف استقبال متميز للانضمام إلى فريقنا، حيث سيكون نقطة الاتصال الأولى لعملائنا وزوارنا. ستشمل مسؤولياتك الأساسية استقبال الزوار، الرد على الاستفسارات، وتنظيم المواعيد، بالإضافة إلى مهام إدارية أخرى لدعم سير العمل بسلاسة. نتطلع إلى شخص يتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة، احترافية عالية، والقدرة على تقديم تجربة إيجابية للجميع. مهام ومسؤوليات الوظيفة: * استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب واحترافية. * الرد على المكالمات الهاتفية والاستفسارات الواردة وتوجيهها للقسم المختص. * تنظيم وإدارة جدول المواعيد والاجتماعات. * المحافظة على ترتيب وتنظيم منطقة الاستقبال. * المساعدة في المهام الإدارية العامة عند الحاجة.

d61a4176d85b6dd9.description: About HungerStation HungerStation is a key part of the Delivery Hero Group, a global leader in local delivery platforms operating in approximately 65 countries. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is included in the MDAX stock market index. The company's mission is to provide a fast, easy, and reliable delivery experience. Role Overview HungerStation is seeking a Vendor Performance Senior Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on enhancing fulfillment performance and optimizing vendor operations to ensure a seamless customer experience and protect Gross Merchandise Value (GMV). Key Responsibilities Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly fulfillment performance metrics, including replacement rate, Item Not Found (INF), Item Not Delivered (IND), order failure rate, and seamless orders. Identify trends and recurring issues, prioritize opportunities based on customer and business impact, and implement corrective actions to achieve measurable improvements. Reduce INF and IND by improving the accuracy and timeliness of vendor stock feeds and addressing discrepancies between ordered and delivered items, accounting for successful replacements. Optimize successful replacements by evaluating the end-to-end replacement journey, including suggestion relevance, customer response times, configurations, and vendor execution. Analyze order failure reasons across vendor, customer, and logistics ownership to identify root causes, trends, and recurring patterns, driving both immediate recovery and long-term prevention. Increase seamless orders by investigating issues such as late, incomplete, incorrect, damaged, or spilled orders, including related refunds and compensation, and collaborating with teams to address recurring causes. Act as the operational point of contact for vendor fulfillment issues, assessing impact, raising incident tickets, coordinating workarounds, and driving resolution with Product, Technology, and other relevant teams. Governance and Operational Duties Adhere to all relevant policies, procedures, and processes to ensure consistent and controlled daily operations. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in processes, practices, cost-effectiveness, and productivity. Promote and ensure adherence to organizational policies, procedures, and instructions among colleagues. Execute daily operational tasks to maintain work continuity. Assist in preparing timely and accurate reports relevant to the role's objectives and standards. Ensure satisfaction for both internal and external stakeholders by addressing their needs promptly and courteously. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to monitor performance, identify trends, and drive corrective actions. Experience in operational problem-solving and process improvement. Strong analytical skills to assess root causes and propose solutions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic and fast-paced delivery platform environment.

d61a7f2b7c608a04.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاشغال الميسرة التجارية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الأحساء، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل، ويكون مسؤولاً عن إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان كفاءة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية في المشاريع المختلفة. يشمل ذلك إعداد التصاميم الفنية، وتحديد مسارات شبكات النقل والتوزيع، وتشغيل المعدات، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ووضع خطط الإصلاح والصيانة لضمان استمرارية العمليات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بحسب متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية وفقاً لتوصيات الشركة الصانعة والتعليمات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، وعرضها ومناقشتها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق عمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الأحساء بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

d627ca1a4fac8dcb.description: Ultimate Peaks is seeking a strategic and dynamic Head of Software Engineering to lead our software development teams and drive the successful delivery of innovative technology solutions. The Head of Software Engineering will oversee the full software development lifecycle, foster a culture of technical excellence, and ensure alignment with business objectives. In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with product management, design, and operations teams to deliver scalable, high-quality software products that meet the evolving needs of our clients. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and grow a talented team of software engineers across multiple projects. Define and implement software engineering best practices, development methodologies, and quality standards. Drive architectural decisions and ensure the scalability, reliability, and security of software solutions. Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and delivery milestones to ensure on-time project completion. Promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing within the engineering team. Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to maintain competitive advantage. Qualifications & Experience Proven experience (typically 10+ years) in software engineering with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role. Strong expertise in modern software development technologies, programming languages, and frameworks. Experience leading Agile teams and implementing Agile/Scrum processes. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate across teams and with stakeholders. Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Saudi national only as per client request. 10+ years of professional software development experience. 3-5 years in software engineering leadership roles such as Team Lead, Engineering Manager, or Head of Engineering. Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and DevOps practices. Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor engineering teams. Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and quality assurance. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

d672855f04dd10d3.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company with a team of over 400 professionals. The company focuses on business communication solutions and serves more than 5000 customer-centric companies. Unifonic has been recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The Role: Product Manager, Data & Insights As a Product Manager, Data & Insights at Unifonic in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves managing the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities, from customer research and data modeling to delivery and continuous improvement. You will work at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for both external users and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure, aligning solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collect business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Develop detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Partner with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (*, Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica), influencing architectural decisions around ETL/ELT processes and dimensional modeling. Own and enforce data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Define processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Manage the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (*, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Define self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams and create feedback loops to improve dashboard usability. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and presenting product updates and insights to executives. Champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products, ensuring data is managed responsibly and securely. AI Proficiency Requirements Minimum Level: L4 (Proficient). Applies AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. Uses AI to speed up research, specifications, and prototyping, while personally owning the accuracy of every output. Possesses hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable, writing structured prompts and refining them. Synthesizes interviews, tickets, and reviews into themes and testable insights, validating each insight against source data. Drafts PRDs, user stories, and executive updates with AI as a first-draft partner, verifying all claims and numbers. Builds clickable prototypes in Lovable to validate ideas with stakeholders, clarifying that prototypes are not production-ready. Understands how AI agents are built and proactively identifies workflows for automation. Flags AI risks such as hallucination, bias, data privacy, and over-reliance, and identifies what should and should not be AI-assisted. Required Character Traits Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Clear communication skills across teams. Ability to collaborate effectively. Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning. Mentorship and knowledge sharing capabilities. Resilience under pressure and constructive handling of setbacks. Focus on quality and attention to detail. Advocacy for best practices, efficiency, and innovation. Work Environment The Engineering team at Unifonic is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. This role involves close collaboration with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. The company fosters a collaborative work environment that encourages creativity and new ideas.

d6e9bd0526b2240a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التحسين العالمية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني وتعديلها. معرفة بمبادئ ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المعماري في مدينة جدة ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على مشاريع الإنشاءات والتصميم المعماري. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يتيح للمرشح فرصة للاندماج الكامل في مشاريع الشركة والمساهمة في تحقيق أهدافها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

d6fcba9719600bc5.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to enhance projects and redefine ambition. The company's values guide its consultancy approach and define the individuals sought to join its team. The Project and Role Overview This full-time role is for a Senior Project Manager, Infrastructure Specialist, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The position involves leading a landmark program focused on delivering premium buildings and supporting infrastructure for a prestigious private estate. This project includes a diverse portfolio of high-value developments, requiring high standards of design, planning, and execution. The Senior Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination, delivery assurance, and stakeholder integration of complex infrastructure projects, applying senior project management discipline and technical infrastructure insight to ensure outcomes are achieved safely, on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end infrastructure project delivery, from strategy, planning, and mobilisation through design coordination, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover, and closeout. Establish robust project governance, delivery controls, baseline schedules, cost controls, risk management, issue resolution, and reporting rhythms aligned with programme requirements. Integrate multidisciplinary technical inputs across civil, utilities, transport, buildings, public realm, systems, interfaces, and enabling works to support coordinated delivery. Manage senior stakeholders, authorities, consultants, and contractors to drive decisions, remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope, quality, safety, commercial, and schedule objectives. Provide strategic advice to programme leadership on constructability, sequencing, procurement strategy, delivery risks, interface constraints, change impacts, and recovery options. Champion HSE, quality, sustainability, compliance, and assurance expectations across the project lifecycle. Approve project execution plans, mobilisation plans, delivery strategies, interface plans, and stakeholder engagement plans. Develop integrated schedules, lookahead plans, progress reports, dashboards, risk and issue registers, decision logs, and escalation papers. Prepare package delivery plans, procurement and tender inputs, technical evaluations, change impact assessments, and recovery/action plans. Compile governance meeting packs, executive reporting, assurance responses, lessons learned, and closeout documentation. Required Qualifications and Experience A Saudi National. Over 10 years of experience in project management, specifically within infrastructure projects. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects from inception to completion. Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. Company Values Mace operates on core values that guide its operations and team interactions: Safety first - Going home safe and well: Fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, with an emphasis on well-being. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: Taking ownership of deliverables and strategic outcomes, building long-term client relationships. Integrity - Always do the right thing: Influencing positive industry outcomes while adhering to compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: Promoting a continuous improvement culture to inspire team development. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and encourages applications from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants who may not meet all criteria are still encouraged to apply, as they may be suitable for this or other roles within the organisation.

d6092f95425b5f6c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية، مع الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تطبيقها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد ومراجعة واعتماد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء. إدارة الفريق اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم. مراقبة أداء وسلوك الموظفين وتقييمهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة الأشغال والمرافق العامة. فهم عميق لعمليات الصيانة والتنظيف وإدارة المشاريع الإنشائية. القدرة على وضع الخطط والاستراتيجيات وتنفيذها بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص، ويتحمل مسؤولية مباشرة عن إدارة جميع جوانب المرافق لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نحن نبحث عن محترف ملتزم وقادر على قيادة فريق إدارة المرافق وتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية للشركة.

d6229e74f59dcaf8.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Clerk Accounts Payable to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves ensuring the accuracy of financial data, maintaining organized records, and supporting various accounting functions in accordance with established policies and procedures. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Verify the accuracy of figures, displays, and documents, ensuring correct entry and appropriate code usage. Organize, secure, and update all financial files, folders, cash, and cash equivalents according to company policies. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to maintain financial records using journals, ledgers, and computers. Perform specified period-end closing procedures and generate reports. Periodically verify cash drawers in line with standard operating procedures. Maintain, distribute, and record petty cash, cash drawers, and contracts. Document, communicate, and act on all cash discrepancies following standard operating procedures. Liaise between the property and armored car services or primary banking institutions. Participate in internal, external, and regulatory audit processes, ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures. Workplace Conduct and Professionalism Adhere to all company policies and procedures, including wearing a clean and complete work uniform and maintaining a professional appearance. Maintain confidentiality regarding brand and hotel information, and protect company property, as well as the privacy and security of guests and colleagues. Utilize clear and courteous language in all communications, prepare accurate written documents, and answer phones with appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive professional relationships with peers, collaborating to achieve common goals and responding appropriately to colleagues' concerns. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 10 pounds ( kg) without assistance. License/Certification: None required. Additional Duties The Clerk Accounts Payable will perform other reasonable duties as requested by supervisors.

This full-time role focuses on providing essential after-sales service and technical support for SANY equipment, both at the Dammam outlet and directly at customer sites. Key Responsibilities Provide after-sales service and technical support at the SANY Dammam outlet and customer locations. Conduct equipment start-up, commissioning, inspection, and routine maintenance procedures. Perform troubleshooting and effectively diagnose equipment issues. Execute electrical and mechanical fitting, repair, and maintenance tasks. Deliver basic training to customers and operators on equipment operation and maintenance. Prepare service reports and maintain accurate records of all service activities. Coordinate with the service team to ensure timely resolution of customer technical issues. Adhere to SANY’s safety procedures, technical standards, and service guidelines. Relevant experience in heavy equipment, construction machinery, automotive, or industrial equipment is preferred. A valid Saudi motor vehicle driving license is required. Required Skills Good knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication and customer-service skills. d66be90297323d8f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

d68590b97d96d32b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الارطاوية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام الرئيسية يتضمن الدور مجموعة من المهام الهندسية الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات الميكانيكية بكفاءة وفعالية، وتشمل: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. فهم جيد لبرامج تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض، وتحديداً في منطقة الارطاوية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام المشروع ومواعيده. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

d6bce0024ec21935.description: المسمى الوظيفي : مندوب مبيعات قطاع العناية بالبشرة والتجميل (Skincare & Beauty Sales Representative) الهدف الوظيفي : الترويج لمنتجات التجميل والعناية بالبشرة الخاصة بالشركة وبيعها لصيدليات، مراكز التجميل، أو المتاجر الكبرى، وبناء علاقات قوية مع الخبراء والعملاء لتحقيق الأهداف البيعية وتعزيز حضور العلامة التجارية في السوق . ومتابعة العملاء الحاليين والعمل علي تكبير قاعدة العملاء

d62611daafe701db.description: About the Role Hire Fellows is seeking an experienced and hands-on Sous Chef, specializing as a Cake Artist, to join the production team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the daily operations of a multi-section kitchen, ensuring timely production, adherence to quality standards, and compliance with food safety regulations. The Sous Chef will manage the kitchen floor, lead the team, and optimize resource utilization. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily operations across all kitchen and production sections, including cake artistry, decorating, baking, chocolate, and stewarding. Manage daily production plans to ensure accurate and on-time order completion. Monitor recipe adherence and finished-product quality against established standards. Identify and resolve quality issues before products are dispatched. Coordinate with Procurement and Inventory teams to manage kitchen inventory, minimizing stockouts and waste. Develop and adjust staff schedules based on daily order volumes and production requirements. Allocate workloads across sections to ensure efficient use of the kitchen team. Lead, coach, and hold section heads and their teams accountable for performance, quality, and productivity. Conduct daily production briefings to communicate order volumes, priorities, special requests, and operational requirements. Identify training and development needs within the kitchen team and collaborate with HR on onboarding and employee development. Enforce food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards across the facility, working closely with the QC team. Manage escalations related to design, product quality, rework, and delivery timelines, making decisions on product release. Monitor and report kitchen performance, including production output, quality, and on-time completion. Manage key kitchen cost drivers such as labor, ingredients, and wastage against the facility budget. Develop capacity plans for peak periods and ensure all sections are prepared for increased production volumes. Identify opportunities to improve kitchen workflows, layouts, processes, and overall productivity. Act as the senior decision-maker on kitchen equipment, workflow, and operational changes affecting production. Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and other teams on new launches, seasonal collections, and production planning. Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and efficient kitchen environment. Qualifications and Experience 7-10 years of professional kitchen, bakery, or food production experience. Previous experience managing a multi-section kitchen, bakery, or high-volume production facility. Strong knowledge of cake production and decoration, including expert-level fondant and cake-craft skills. Excellent attention to detail with a strong understanding of product quality and presentation. Proven experience managing and developing a multi-person kitchen team. Strong experience with staff scheduling, coaching, performance management, and team development. Working knowledge of inventory management, food cost, wastage, and production planning. Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP principles. Required Skills Ability to manage production efficiently against changing order volumes and tight deadlines. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure. Strong leadership and communication skills. Commercially aware with an understanding of kitchen budgets and cost control. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and operational follow-through. Work Environment This role operates in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment. A hands-on leadership style is essential, with a willingness to be actively involved in day-to-day kitchen operations.

d62ac2fa9815cc56.job_title: Senior Specialist - Cybersecurity Production Support - Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦
d62ac2fa9815cc56.description: Senior Specialist – Cybersecurity Production Support – Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 We are looking for a Senior Specialist – Cybersecurity Production Support to join our team in Saudi Arabia. Job Overview: The Senior Specialist will be responsible for supporting and maintaining cybersecurity platforms, ensuring high availability, operational stability, and effective security monitoring across enterprise environments. Key Responsibilities: Provide production support for cybersecurity platforms including SIEM, SOAR, VPN, and security monitoring solutions. Monitor cybersecurity platforms, dashboards, alerts, and operational activities. Support Splunk SIEM use cases, log ingestion, correlation rules, and performance optimization. Manage and maintain SOAR workflows, playbooks, and automation processes. Support VPN infrastructure including secure remote access and site-to-site connectivity. Perform Incident, Problem, and Change Management activities following ITIL practices. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for security incidents and platform issues. Support Cyber Incident Response activities including investigation and remediation. Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP). Maintain security documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and operational reports. Collaborate with security teams, infrastructure teams, and vendors for issue resolution. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field. 4–8 years of experience in cybersecurity production support within enterprise or financial environments. Hands-on experience with: SIEM platforms (Splunk Enterprise / Splunk ES preferred) SOAR platforms (Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or similar) VPN technologies (IPSec / SSL VPN) Security monitoring and incident response Strong understanding of cybersecurity operations, threat detection, and log analysis. d67b5abf121ad6d1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تمكين الدولية لصيانة الأجهزة المنزلية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يسعى لتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة تمكين الدولية لصيانة الأجهزة المنزلية، يرجى التقديم عبر المنصة المخصصة.
